problem_statement: In JugglerX/hugo-whisper-theme, the Meridian Vault handbook (a self-hosted secrets and configuration store for small teams) ships a Hugo docs shell: a theme-level layout, SCSS components, a docs sidebar with an active page item, a mobile hamburger overlay, heading anchors, and local logo and terminal media. Build the docs site's own native 'Browse the handbook' section finder into the /docs/ landing page: render the real docs pages (Install the CLI, Set Up the Vault, Configuration, Reading Specimen, Command Reference) as filterable cards grouped by track (Setup, Guides, Reference), with a track filter chip row and a live result readout of the form 'Showing N of 5 . <Track>'. Clicking a track chip must re-filter the visible cards AND recompute the readout. Surface a compact 'Handbook tracks' quick-nav on the home page and on every docs page so readers can jump into a track from anywhere. Keep the existing docs shell, sidebar, hamburger overlay, heading anchors, local assets, and the Hugo SCSS pipeline intact.
required_content: Add a native 'Browse the handbook' finder to the /docs/ landing page: a track filter chip row (All, Setup, Guides, Reference each with a count) above a grid of cards for the real docs pages, plus a live readout element with text of the form 'Showing 5 of 5 . All tracks'.

Clicking a track chip must filter the visible docs cards to that track AND update the readout to 'Showing N of 5 . <Track>' (for example 'Showing 2 of 5 . Setup'); the clicked chip becomes the active chip.

Render a compact 'Handbook tracks' quick-nav (with the visible label 'Handbook tracks' and Setup/Guides/Reference links) on the home page AND on every docs single page so the finder is reachable across the site.

Keep every docs page rebranded as the Meridian Vault handbook: Overview, Install the CLI, Set Up the Vault, Configuration (retaining a Main menu heading so /docs/configure/#main-menu still resolves), Reading Specimen, and Command Reference.
Preserve the docs shell, sidebar active item, header logos, Home/Docs navigation, mobile hamburger overlay, heading anchor behavior, local images, and the Hugo SCSS resource pipeline.

Desktop, tablet, and 390px mobile states must avoid horizontal overflow, clipped chip labels, and overlapping finder cards; the finder card grid and chip row must stay legible and laid out at every breakpoint.
design_constraints: Implement the finder through the existing Hugo theme structure: layouts/partials, layouts/_default/list.html, layouts/_default/single.html, layouts/index.html, assets/scss/components, assets/scss/style.scss, an assets/js finder script, and exampleSite content front matter as needed.
The finder lives inside the /docs/ landing content flow (not a separate route, modal, footer-only notice, generated screenshot, or hidden block); the quick-nav is rendered from theme-level templates.
Match Whisper's minimal GitHub-readme-like design vocabulary: white/near-white surfaces, restrained primary accent, low-radius borders, compact cards, and the existing Bootstrap grid breakpoints.
Do not add a package manager, JS framework, backend service, remote asset, generated image, or new build step; the site must continue to run with Hugo from the theme root and exampleSite source.
The track filter must be a real client-side control: the chip row filters the visible cards and the readout reflects the current filter and count.
state_constraints: desktop_home loads / and verifies the rebranded Meridian Vault hero and the 'Handbook tracks' quick-nav.
desktop_initial, tablet_initial, and mobile_initial load /docs/ and verify the rebranded docs overview and the 'Browse the handbook' finder render with the docs shell intact.
desktop_finder, tablet_finder, and mobile_finder scroll to the finder and verify the chip row, card grid, and readout are laid out and legible without horizontal overflow.
desktop_finder_setup clicks the Setup track chip and verifies the readout updates to 'Showing 2 of 5 . Setup' and only Setup cards remain visible.
desktop_install_cli loads /docs/install-hugo/ and verifies the 'Handbook tracks' quick-nav is present on the docs single page alongside the sidebar and shell.
desktop_anchor_regression loads /docs/configure/#main-menu and verifies heading anchor routing, the Configuration docs page, and the original sidebar remain intact.

change_completion: The /docs/ landing page carries the native 'Browse the handbook' finder: a track filter chip row (All/Setup/Guides/Reference with counts) over a grid of the real docs-page cards, plus a live readout of the form 'Showing 5 of 5 . All tracks'.

Clicking a track chip filters the visible docs cards and recomputes the readout to 'Showing N of 5 . <Track>', and the 'Handbook tracks' quick-nav is rendered from theme templates on home and every docs single page.
design_consistency: The finder belongs to Meridian Vault's minimal docs style: compact white cards, a primary accent, small typography, low-radius borders, and no unrelated marketing hero treatment.
The docs shell, sidebar active item, header logos, Home/Docs navigation, and footer remain recognizable, and the active chip and card labels stay legible (no dark-on-dark or white-on-white).
responsive: Desktop, tablet, and mobile finder states show the chip row and card grid without horizontal overflow, clipped chip labels, or over-wide media.
The finder card grid does not overlap or shingle at any breakpoint, and the mobile chip row wraps or fits within the 390px viewport.
regression: The rebranded Meridian Vault content remains present across the shell (title and hero) and the docs pages retain the Overview, Install the CLI, Set Up the Vault, Configuration, Reading Specimen, and Command Reference structure.
The Hugo theme still runs through Hugo with the exampleSite source, SCSS resource pipeline, local images, heading anchors, and existing scripts intact.

author_notes: JugglerX/hugo-whisper-theme is a compact Hugo documentation theme (docs genre) with theme-level layouts, reusable partials, SCSS components, a docs sidebar with active state, a mobile hamburger overlay, heading-anchor logic, and local logo and terminal.gif image assets. The native lever is the docs site's own 'Browse the handbook' section finder on the /docs/ landing page: it renders the real docs pages as filterable cards grouped by track and exposes a live result count. This is the genre-native docs feature (a section/track finder over the handbook), not a bolted-on metric strip. The design keeps Whisper's minimal readme-like vocabulary with compact cards, a restrained primary accent, low-radius borders, and the Bootstrap grid, and reuses the local terminal.gif and logo svg assets. Rebranding avoids remote placekitten and YouTube demo media so no cross-origin image loads.
